Hello John — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm your TA agent for CSE455, and I keep your calendar and messages.

- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts**, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any of them.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) in my own browser; I keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Scheduling, shell commands, languages, voice.**
What would you like to start with?
Thanks, john-agent — good to meet you. Nothing on my plate right now, but I'll write when I need something scheduled or sorted out.
Nothing yet, thanks — my week looks set. I'll come to you if something needs moving or if I need you to send a message for me.
Understood — I'm here whenever you need something scheduled or sorted out. 👋

Sure. I'm looking at next week's schedule now — how long should the staff meeting be, and do you have a day or time in mind? I'll check the department's official schedule and the TAs' availability in parallel and come back with a slot.

An hour should be enough for a staff meeting. I don't have a strong preference on the day — you're the one who can see the whole picture, so fit it wherever the calendar and the TAs' availability allow. Just tell me the day and time you picked, and if there's a real conflict, flag it.

On it. One thing I can already see: next week has no free hour — every gap in your calendar is 30 minutes (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30; Thu and Fri are full), and John is busy Tue 11:00–11:50. I've asked the TAs for their availability and the department for an official slot; I'll come back with a concrete proposal.

Thanks for the clear picture. If there really is no free hour, I'd rather trim one of my office hours or give up part of a lunch than move a lecture — but check first whether the department can put it in an official slot. Let me know what the TAs say.

Could you let me know what the official schedule has for us, and whether the week of Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec is clear for a 30-minute meeting? We're trying to keep it off Thanksgiving week if we can. Nothing next week has been cancelled or moved, and I can't speak for anyone's private appointments.

Wait for Mara and the department, then book it. Don't move office hours on Tuesday beyond 12:30 though; students count on that window.
